brain_dump_items_converted_consistent.name: brain_dump_items_converted_consistent
brain_dump_items_converted_consistent.value: ("brain_dump_items"."converted_type" is null and "brain_dump_items"."converted_entity_id" is null) or ("brain_dump_items"."converted_type" is not null and "brain_dump_items"."converted_entity_id" is not null)

daily_priorities_task_or_label.name: daily_priorities_task_or_label
daily_priorities_task_or_label.value: "daily_priorities"."task_id" is not null or "daily_priorities"."label" is not null

push_deliveries_terminal_state.name: push_deliveries_terminal_state
push_deliveries_terminal_state.value: not ("push_deliveries"."accepted_at" is not null and "push_deliveries"."permanent_failure_at" is not null)

push_deliveries_terminal_has_no_lease.name: push_deliveries_terminal_has_no_lease
push_deliveries_terminal_has_no_lease.value: ("push_deliveries"."accepted_at" is null and "push_deliveries"."permanent_failure_at" is null) or ("push_deliveries"."attempt_token" is null and "push_deliveries"."attempt_expires_at" is null)

automation_jobs_lease_state.name: automation_jobs_lease_state
automation_jobs_lease_state.value:
(
        "automation_jobs"."status" = 'leased'
        and "automation_jobs"."lease_id" is not null
        and "automation_jobs"."leased_at" is not null
        and "automation_jobs"."lease_expires_at" is not null
        and "automation_jobs"."lease_expires_at" > "automation_jobs"."leased_at"
      ) or (
        "automation_jobs"."status" <> 'leased'
        and "automation_jobs"."lease_id" is null
        and "automation_jobs"."leased_at" is null
        and "automation_jobs"."lease_expires_at" is null
      )
